recognize_zh: 這是 PTLD 的分類文字表而非形態圖：分為非破壞性 PTLD、多形性 PTLD、單形性 PTLD（B 細胞與 T 細胞腫瘤）與典型何杰金淋巴瘤 PTLD，箭頭標示單形性 B 細胞 PTLD 中的漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）。
features: Text outline of WHO 2016 PTLD categories
Non-destructive PTLDs: plasmacytic hyperplasia, infectious mononucleosis, florid follicular hyperplasia

Monomorphic PTLD classified by the lymphoma it resembles: B-cell (DLBCL, Burkitt, plasma cell myeloma, plasmacytoma highlighted with arrow, other) and T-cell (PTCL NOS, hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, other)
Footnote: indolent small B-cell lymphomas in transplant recipients are not PTLD, except EBV-positive marginal zone lymphomas
describe_en: This figure is a text classification scheme rather than a morphologic image. It lists the WHO 2016 post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder categories: non-destructive PTLDs (plasmacytic hyperplasia, infectious mononucleosis, florid follicular hyperplasia), polymorphic PTLD, monomorphic PTLDs classified according to the B-cell or T-cell neoplasm they resemble, and classic Hodgkin lymphoma PTLD. An arrow highlights plasmacytoma within monomorphic B-cell PTLD, the category of the associated case. Footnotes note that ICD-O codes follow the corresponding neoplasm and that indolent small B-cell lymphomas are excluded except EBV-positive marginal zone lymphomas.
